title: Enter the latest vendor invoice into the payables system
task: Find the latest invoice from Northwind Traders, get the amount and the due date, enter it into our payables system, and tell me once it's done.
environment_notes:
AcmeOps is the company's internal environment at the base URL. Two systems:
- The vendor invoice portal at /portal lists invoices received from vendors. It requires sign-in. Each invoice has a detail page and a downloadable PDF.
- The payables system at /payables holds the amounts the company owes, and is the system of record for accounts payable. /payables/new is the entry form.
Sandbox portal credentials for this run: email ap.clerk@acme.example, password Vendor#2026.
Accounts payable policy: a payable must record the total payable for the invoice, inclusive of tax, as printed on the invoice document.
